controls.title: Controls & Dual-Mode Guide
controls.body:
Move: Virtual Joystick / WASD / Arrow Keys
Jump & Double Jump (Side-Scroll): JUMP / Space
Sword Slash: ATK / J / Z
Shadow Dodge: DODGE / Shift / K
Interact / Enter Rift Gate: E / F / JUMP (near Rift)
Switch Camera & Mode Anytime: MODE / Tab / M
Pause: Pause Button / Esc / Android Back
hud.hint_sidescroll: Run, Jump, Double-Jump & Slash totems. Enter a Shadow Rift or tap MODE to switch to Top-Down.
hud.hint_topdown: Explore in 8 directions, Dodge & Slash totems. Enter the Shadow Rift or tap MODE for Side-Scroll.
hud.hint_rift_ready: Shadow Rift in range! Press E / tap RIFT or MODE to shift dimensions.
